errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis categories are arranged in alphabetical order. They are arranged in ascending order of EGDI value: Ниско (Low), Средно (Medium), Високо (High), Много високо (Very High).

The description incorrectly maps the five distinct colors for the years to only two color names. It states that 2014 and 2016 have the same color ('светлосин') and that 2012, 2018, and 2020 have the same color ('тъмносин'), which is not true. The legend and the bars show five different shades of blue for the five years.

errors.evidence: The description lists all 20 individual data points from the chart. This is excessively detailed and makes the text difficult to parse for key information. A summary of trends or key values, as seen in the reference description, would be more effective.
